gaps.title: Section 87A rebate applicability on Special Rate Income under Section 115BAC
gaps.description: Income Tax Department utility updates for AY 2024-25 restricted Section 87A rebate against short-term capital gains (Section 111A) and long-term capital gains (Section 112A) under the New Tax Regime, despite statutory wording ambiguities in the Income-tax Act. Need authoritative ITAT rulings and CBDT clarification circulars.
gaps.actionPlan: Monitor CBDT notifications and pending ITAT appeals regarding rebate calculation order.

gaps.title: Small & Medium REIT (SM REIT) initial listing mechanics and secondary market liquidity
gaps.description: SEBI introduced the SM REIT regulatory framework in March 2024 to regulate fractional ownership of commercial properties with asset sizes between ₹50 Cr and ₹500 Cr. Live listing track records, liquidity, and distribution yield data are currently minimal.
gaps.actionPlan: Track initial SM REIT scheme registrations on SEBI portal and exchange listings on BSE/NSE.

gaps.title: Operational reconciliation of 20% TCS on LRS outward remittances with advance tax filings
gaps.description: Under revised LRS rules, 20% TCS is levied on overseas investments exceeding ₹7 Lakh per financial year. While this TCS is adjustable against domestic tax liability, real-world cashflow drag and automated bank deduction errors remain widespread.
gaps.actionPlan: Verify exact Form 26AS/AIS credit reflection timelines and Form 12BAA corporate adjustment mechanisms.

gaps.title: Empirical lifestyle and education inflation metrics for Indian metro cities
gaps.description: Official CPI prints average 4-6%, but urban middle-class and affluent lifestyle inflation (healthcare, private school and higher education tuition, lifestyle housing) runs between 8-12% annually. Need robust multi-decade empirical data sets.
gaps.actionPlan: Synthesize private expenditure surveys, healthcare inflation studies, and Tier 1 education fee escalation rates.

gaps.title: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) future issuance policy after Budget 2024 customs duty reduction
gaps.description: Following the reduction of gold import duty from 15% to 6% in Union Budget 2024, the Ministry of Finance and RBI have paused fresh SGB tranche issuances. The government's long-term policy on future tranches and fiscal cost needs primary confirmation.
gaps.actionPlan: Track RBI issuance calendars and Ministry of Finance borrowing announcements for FY 2025-26.
